title: semver: locate why build-metadata versions sort wrongly
prompt: In this copy of node-semver, versions that differ only in build metadata sort in the wrong order once the build numbers have different digit counts: `semver.sort(['1.2.3+build.100','1.2.3+build.20','1.2.3+build.3'])` does not give `['1.2.3+build.3','1.2.3+build.20','1.2.3+build.100']`, and `compareBuild('1.0.0+20','1.0.0+100')` is not -1. Trace how sorting and build comparison are done, find the root cause and fix it with a minimal change. Numeric identifiers must still sort below alphanumeric ones.
